data.name: Porto Palácio Hotel by The Editory
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Amenities
The 5-star Porto Palacio boasts a rooftop lounge with breathtaking views, a lavish spa, and an indoor pool. Enjoy the squash court, fitness center, and massage rooms for a truly indulgent stay.

Modern Elegance
Step into the soundproofed, modern rooms offering a 26-inch flat-screen TV, plush seating, and a well-stocked minibar. The marble bathrooms with underfloor heating provide a touch of luxury, while free WiFi keeps you connected.

Convenient Location
Situated on Avenida da Boavista, this hotel is a short walk from Estádio do Bessa and close to metro stations for easy access to Casa da Música and the city center. With Porto International Airport nearby, your journey is seamless.

Experience luxury and convenience at Porto Palacio - book your stay now for an unforgettable getaway.
data.hotelImportantInformation:
Please note that guests are required to wear a swimming cap when entering the swimming pools. The Health Club and Porto Palácio Spa may have schedule changes or close in festive seasons like Christmas, New Year, Carnival, and Easter. SPA access is not included on the rates. Please contact the property directly for more details.

Guests requiring an invoice should include their invoicing details (name, address and VAT number) in the Special Requests box when booking. Please note that invoices cannot be changed after they are emitted.

The credit card used at time of booking must be valid for the entire stay. Please present the credit card used to make your reservation upon check-in at the hotel. Please note that in the event that you cannot produce the same credit card the hotel reserves the right to ask for an alternative method of payment. Please note that the hotel does not accept third party bookings paid by credit card. Please contact the hotel directly for information regarding bank transfers.

Extra beds are subject to availability and confirmation.

When booking more than 9 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply.

The minimum age to access the spa is 16 years and the minimum age to use the gym is 18 years old. Children may use the swimming pool as long as always accompanied by an adult.

Consumption of minibar contents available in the room will incur in additional costs.Guests are required to show a photo ID and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.
Please inform  of your expected arrival time in advance. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly using the contact details in your confirmation.
A deposit may be required at the property.

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Several mentions of cleanliness issues, including concerns about the carpet and water leakage.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Most reviews highlight friendly and attentive staff, ensuring a good service experience.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Convenient location with easy access to the city center noted positively.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Spacious and comfortable rooms, but some issues with heating and water temperature.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Facilities such as the fitness center and pool were criticized for being below 5-star standards.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Some concerns about parking fees and amenities not meeting expectations for a 5-star hotel.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast described as excellent with a variety of choices to cater to different tastes.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Most guests expressed a desire to return, indicating a generally positive overall experience.
